caption:
She gave up a pediatrics career in the US. To build a hospital for one of India's most overlooked regions.

Dr. Lata Desai trained in medicine in Gujarat, moved to the US in 1972 to specialize in pediatrics, then returned to India with her husband Dr. Anil Desai to found SEWA Rural in 1980 in Jhagadia, Bharuch district. For over four decades, SEWA Rural has provided health, education and women's empowerment services to tribal Adivasi communities in South Gujarat. She received the Padma Shri in 2022 for four decades of sustained grassroots health work.

A settled medical career in America was already hers. She chose a harder one in a village most of India had never heard of.

Sources: Wikipedia, DNA India (1980-2022)
